invariants.name: AI Prescription Approval Barrier
invariants.description: Autonomous AI copilot prescription approval is strictly blocked.
invariants.evidence: NuskhaStateMachine enforces clinician approval only; AI actor rejected with 403 Forbidden

invariants.name: Admin Clinical Prescribing Barrier
invariants.description: IT / System Administrator (SUPER_ADMIN) prescribing is strictly barred.
invariants.evidence: AdministrativePrescriptionForbiddenException raised if role is SUPER_ADMIN without statutory practitioner license

invariants.name: Unverified Clinician Sign-off Barrier
invariants.description: Unregistered / unverified clinician prescription sign-off fails closed.
invariants.evidence: UnverifiedClinicianException raised when practitioner registration status != ACTIVE

invariants.name: Safety BLOCK Hard-Stop
invariants.description: Prescription with safety status BLOCK cannot be approved under any circumstances.
invariants.evidence: Approval button hard-disabled; SafetyBlockException raised on backend commit attempt

invariants.name: Safety UNKNOWN Fail-Closed
invariants.description: Prescription with UNKNOWN safety evaluation must fail closed.

invariants.name: Safety CAUTION Signed Justification
invariants.description: CAUTION safety status requires explicit signed clinician justification rationale.
invariants.evidence: Requires minimum 15 character rationale and legal risk affirmation checkbox before approval is unblocked

invariants.name: Schedule E(1) Mudabbar Detoxification Gate
invariants.description: Schedule E(1) poisons require mandatory Mudabbar certification and strict dosage ceilings.
invariants.evidence: Mudabbar certificate validated against lot tracking before pharmacy dispensing

invariants.name: Confusable Species Disambiguation
invariants.description: Confusable commercial species (Asaroon vs Tagar, Chiraita vs Kalmegh) must be flagged.
invariants.evidence: Disambiguation check triggers mandatory botanical verification dialog

invariants.name: Preclinical Extrapolation Prohibition
invariants.description: In-vitro (E1) or animal (E2) evidence cannot assert proven human clinical efficacy.
invariants.evidence: GRADE rating engine blocks human efficacy claims backed solely by pre-clinical tiers

invariants.name: Closed-Loop Learning Staging Firewall
invariants.description: Learning proposals remain staged and cannot alter runtime rules without board ratification.
invariants.evidence: Staged candidate updates isolated in research database partition
